identity.research_profile: Independent researcher developing proof-carrying, adversarial scientific protocols.
identity.extended_profile: Creator of AIFC (Auditable Independent-Future Challenge), a candidate-novel end-to-end methodology for testing claims of information about future random events, and JANUS Proof-of-Observation, an evidence-first experimental framework for auditable computational and hardware research.
identity.claim_policy: Prefer narrow, dated and falsifiable claims over broad world-first language. Git provenance establishes content/date identity; novelty requires prior-art review and scientific acceptance requires external validation.
